evidence.observation: H701 temperature reads 433.2 °C, markedly above T702 at 69.9 °C and the reboiler at 69.4 °C.

T701 has risen to 437.9 °C while T702 is 70.6 °C and T703 is 69.9 °C; the persistent discrepancy indicates possible local overheating or a temperature-measurement fault, not an identified thermocouple drift.
Distillate and reflux flows are 0.2 and 0.4; cooling-water flow is 6.8 and both level switches remain at 1. These do not independently validate the H701 temperature.

args.missing_evidence: Independent H701 temperature measurement, heater power and setpoint, and permissible heater temperature are needed to distinguish actual overheating from a sensor/readout fault. No composition measurement or separation target is supplied. Pressure instruments are not installed, so pressure behavior cannot be assessed.
